Reassessed 2026-10-27 for GHSA-965c-763c-88jm and GHSA-r4xp-prcw-77qf. The only in-process Better Auth server (apps/broomva/lib/agent-auth.ts with @better-auth/agent-auth 0.6.2, scoped by the root override) now runs better-auth and @better-auth/core 1.7.12, outside every listed range; GHSA-r4xp-prcw-77qf no longer matches the tree and is not excepted. Every remaining key comes from the Better Auth 1.4.18 copy that Neon Auth 0.4.2-beta pins exactly (with its auth-ui, passkey and daveyplate peers). The app imports only @neondatabase/auth/next and /next/server; their runtime module graph loads only better-auth/client, /client/plugins, /cookies, /react and /types (server plugin paths such as plugins/magic-link appear only in .d.ts types), and /api/auth is forwarded to the hosted NEON_AUTH_BASE_URL, so no 1.4.18 server handler (OAuth callback, state check, magic-link verification, account linking, plugins) runs in-process. Every published Neon Auth release still pins a vulnerable Better Auth (0.5.0-beta 1.6.23; 0.6.0-beta and 0.7.0-beta 1.7.6, below the 1.7.7 fix), so the BRO-2627 migration cannot clear these keys yet. GHSA-q84f-53jg-9ppm requires the opt-in deviceAuthorization() plugin, which the local server does not configure. scripts/auth-device-advisory.test.ts and scripts/auth-oauth-state-advisory.test.ts evaluate the actual local configuration, the installed server version, every Better Auth import site in the app, and Neon's runtime import graph. This is a conditional in-process non-applicability assessment, not a claim that the hosted Neon Auth server is patched against GHSA-965c-763c-88jm; re-review when Neon publishes a release pinning Better Auth >=1.7.7 or this topology changes.

Patched Undici 7.30.1 is pinned for sandbox and jsdom, and Vercel Blob resolves patched 6.29.1. The remaining vulnerable 5.29.0 runtime branch belongs only to ConnectRPC v1 for an operator-configured Life gateway; no patched 5.x release exists. Its Busboy dependency is independently upgraded to 3.2.2 with fragmented multipart and HTTP/2 RPC integration tests. The retained advisory keys still affect Undici 5: caller-controlled proxy, cookie, WebSocket and destination configuration are not exposed, but HTTP parsing and denial-of-service residual risk remains until a ConnectRPC v2 migration. Reassessed 2026-10-27. Topology hash re-recorded the same day: the Better Auth 1.7.12 upgrade changed only the Vitest optional-peer lines that print the Better Auth version. Reassessed 2026-11-17 (BRO-3835) for GHSA-2m5v-pch6-74hx, GHSA-qrxm-fqhp-jwvm and GHSA-9fm3-97px-rjf6, all fixed only in 6.29.1: @connectrpc/connect-node 1.7.0 imports Undici solely in dist/*/node-headers-polyfill.js for the Headers class on Node <18, and its transport uses node:http2/node:https, so Undici's TLS and WebSocket clients are never invoked on the deployed Node 24 runtime. Forcing 6.29.1 was tried and rejected: it breaks the Busboy 3.2.2 multipart compatibility tests in packages/lifegw-client.
